policy: Use visual evidence and adjacent text together. Never borrow dimensions from another case. Preserve unresolved fields as explicit assumptions. Generate geometry-only PyAEDT code and do not start or solve AEDT.

requests.language_input: Reconstruct the L-shaped slot subtraction demonstration exactly from its dimensioned diagram. Create the rectangular copper patch and the single fused L-slot tool only.

Reconstruct only Case 1: the Vivaldi antenna. Combine the front/back topology image with its complete text description. Preserve all 30 described parameters and identify the unpublished updated spline coordinates instead of treating guessed values as paper evidence.

Reconstruct only Case 2: the 2.45 GHz rectangular-slotted rectangular patch. Use the four published dimensions exactly. Infer a usable first geometry from the picture, but label every substrate, material, thickness, feed, ground-extent, and slot-position completion as an engineering assumption.

Reconstruct only Case 3: the quasi-cross-slotted printed monopole. Reconcile the seven solids, the corrected relation SL = ML + DPR + 0.2, the partial-ground relation ML - RPL, FR-4 properties, and the unresolved conductor thickness.
